'''Melissandre Fuentes''' (born March 1, 1988 in [[Canillo]]) is an [[Andorra]]n [[figure skating|figure skater]]. She is the 2004 and 2005 Andorran national champion. Her younger sister [[Lydia Fuentes]] competes internationally on the junior level.<ref>[http://www.isuresults.com/bios/isufs00005473.htm Melissandre Profile]</ref>

Fuentes is the first lady skater to represent Andorra at an ISU Championship, which she accomplished at the [[2002 World Junior Figure Skating Championships]].{{citation needed|date=June 2012}}
